source.name: Thomas Kirchner et al. · Halle micro-CT
source.specimen: Independent 70-year-old male donor skull, Martin-Luther University Halle-Wittenberg
source.acquisition: 125 µm isotropic cone-beam micro-CT; Nikon XT H 225, 150 kV, 400 µA; semi-manual binary bone segmentation
source.modifications: Cropped the pinned binary mask at the recorded voxel bounds; zero-padded it by one voxel to expose rectangular cut faces; extracted every marching-cubes triangle at native 0.125 mm spacing; rigidly reoriented and centered; computed smooth vertex normals. No mesh decimation, geometric smoothing, generated trabeculae, assigned tissue segmentation or registration to another skull.
source.limitations: The source is bone/non-bone only. Compact tables and diploë are visible but are not separately supplied tissue labels. Interpretive layer pins are approximate locations. The donor skull has a preparation cut and a small right-parietal trepanation elsewhere; the crop avoids the visible cut. Header LPS labels do not establish patient orientation of the specimen. This is a separate study sample, not an enlargement or measured thickness map of OUVC 10503.

groups.name: Bone microstructure
groups.description: One real vault fragment · three interpretive layer locations

structures.name: Skull-vault micro-CT fragment
structures.description: A real 17.5 × 17.5 mm surface patch cropped from a separate donor skull's 125 µm micro-CT bone mask. It preserves the compact tables and porous interior in a single mesh. Rectangular cut faces are computational crop boundaries. Layer pins are educational locations, not supplied tissue labels. This fragment is not registered to either full-skull model.

landmarks.name: Outer cortical table
landmarks.description: Dense external plate of the skull vault. This pin identifies an illustrative location on the real binary bone surface; the source does not supply a separate cortical-table tissue label.

landmarks.name: Diploë
landmarks.description: Porous bone between the compact tables. The visible bony network comes directly from the micro-CT bone mask. This is an illustrative location, not a separately segmented diploë region.

landmarks.name: Inner cortical table
landmarks.description: Dense plate facing the cranial cavity. This pin identifies an illustrative location on the real binary bone surface; the source does not supply a separate cortical-table tissue label.
